title: Find the smallest native Linux x64 loader milestone
objective: Trace the Windows host dependencies of the XCL loader from source. Propose the smallest independently testable change toward launching a synthetic title in a native Linux process without Wine or Proton.
acceptance: Cite concrete source paths at the base revision and distinguish OS services from the x86-64 guest ABI
Describe one synthetic pass/fail test that needs no console SDK or game data
State how the first change preserves the Windows path and what it will not prove about graphics or games
